Index: .cargo/config.toml
===================================================================
--- .cargo/config.toml	
+++ .cargo/config.toml	
@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+# This tool targets Windows exclusively, so `cargo build`/`cargo run` produce a
+# Windows binary by default even when invoked from another host.
+#
+# Use the MSVC toolchain (default Rust install on Windows). Swap to
+# "x86_64-pc-windows-gnu" if you would rather build with MinGW, and adjust the
+# triple for 32-bit (i686-) or ARM64 (aarch64-) targets.
+[build]
+target = "x86_64-pc-windows-msvc"

Index: Cargo.lock
===================================================================
--- Cargo.lock	
+++ Cargo.lock	
@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+# This file is automatically @generated by Cargo.
+# It is not intended for manual editing.
+version = 4
+
+[[package]]
+name = "windows-link"
+version = "0.2.1"
+source = "registry+https://github.com/rust-lang/crates.io-index"
+checksum = "f0805222e57f7521d6a62e36fa9163bc891acd422f971defe97d64e70d0a4fe5"
+
+[[package]]
+name = "windows-sys"
+version = "0.61.2"
+source = "registry+https://github.com/rust-lang/crates.io-index"
+checksum = "ae137229bcbd6cdf0f7b80a31df61766145077ddf49416a728b02cb3921ff3fc"
+dependencies = [
+ "windows-link",
+]
+
+[[package]]
+name = "wintool"
+version = "0.1.0"
+dependencies = [
+ "windows-sys",
+]

Index: Cargo.toml
===================================================================
--- Cargo.toml	
+++ Cargo.toml	
@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+[package]
+name = "wintool"
+version = "0.1.0"
+edition = "2024"
+description = "A Windows-only tool using direct Win32 API bindings"
+
+[dependencies]
+
+[target."cfg(windows)".dependencies]
+windows-sys = { version = "0.61.2", features = ["Win32_Foundation", "Win32_System_Threading", "Win32_System_SystemInformation"] }

[build]
